notes: **Scope.** Heisenberg's Uncertainty Principle and concept of probabi… — Atomic Structure, Chemistry (class-11-notes).
**Tested.** define it · list: heisenberg's uncertainty principle, concept of probability · one worked example · one misconception each.
**Fact.** P(E) = favourable/total. Additive law: P(A∪B) = P(A)+P(B)−P(A∩B). If mutually exclusive, P(A∪B)=P(A)+P(B).
**Fact.** Multiplicative: P(A∩B) = P(A)P(B|A); independence: P(A∩B) = P(A)P(B).
**Fact.** Complement: P(A') = 1 − P(A). For discrete: ΣP = 1; expected value E(X) = Σxᵢpᵢ.
**Concept of probability.** one-line definition + one-line exam use.
